questions: Do you work or are you a student?
What subject are you studying?
Why did you choose that subject?
What do you like most about your work or studies?
Where is your hometown?
What do you like about living there?
Has your hometown changed much in recent years?
Would you like to live there in the future?
What do you usually do to stay healthy?
Do you have a regular daily routine?
How often do you visit a doctor or a clinic?
Do you think you get enough sleep and exercise?
How do you usually travel to work or to your place of study?
How long does that journey take?
Do you prefer public transport or travelling by motorbike or car?
What delivery services do you often use in daily life?
How often do you have a health check-up?
What kind of exercise do you do regularly?
Do you try to eat a healthy diet in your daily life?
What do you usually do when you feel unwell?
Do you often buy things online?
What was the last item you ordered for delivery?
How long are you willing to wait for a parcel to arrive?
Do you prefer home delivery or collecting a parcel yourself?

part2.cue: Describe a skill you learned as a child.
points: say what the skill is
say who taught you
say how you learned it
and explain how useful the skill is today

part2.cue: Describe a place you visited that you particularly enjoyed.
points: say where the place is
say when you went there
say what you did there
and explain why you enjoyed it

part2.cue: Describe a person working in healthcare whom you admire.
points: say who the person is
say what their job involves
say when you first met them or heard about them
and explain why you admire them

part2.cue: Describe a delivery or a transport journey that you remember well.
points: say what was being delivered or where the journey was
say who organised it or travelled
say what happened during the delivery or journey
and explain why you remember it

part2.cue: Describe a time when a delivery or a package was important to you.
points: say what the package contained
say who sent it or ordered it for you
say why it was important
and explain how you felt when it arrived

part2.cue: Describe a new medical treatment or health service you have heard about.
points: say what the treatment or service is
say how you heard about it
say who it is designed to help
and explain why you think it is useful

questions: What skills are most useful for adults in daily life?
Should schools teach practical skills such as cooking and managing money?
Can adults learn new skills as easily as children?
Why do so many people enjoy travelling to other countries?
What are the disadvantages of mass tourism?
Will people travel more or less in the future, in your opinion?
What qualities does a good doctor or nurse need?
Why do some countries find it difficult to train enough medical staff?
How can technology change the work of people in healthcare?
How has online shopping changed the delivery industry in your country?
What problems can large delivery networks cause for cities?
Will drones and driverless vehicles replace delivery workers in the future, in your opinion?
Should governments spend more on preventing illness than on treating people who are already ill?
How can public campaigns encourage people to eat better and exercise more?
Do you think regular health check-ups should be free for everyone?
How has online shopping changed the way people in your country buy everyday goods?
What problems can very fast delivery services create for workers and for cities?
Will local shops survive as delivery services continue to grow, in your opinion?
